typed_route_proof_expectations.business_meaning: Customer commitment intent must naturally recall a current Micron shipment, take-or-pay or deposit claim without using qrel IDs in query construction.
HBM supply intent must recall a current issuer-authored capacity, wafer-intensity or yield barrier claim.
The current NVIDIA revenue and Data Center result claim must enter through requested metric and product intent rather than a fixed answer binding.
NVIDIA supply execution intent must naturally recall a capacity commitment, lead-time or supply-demand mismatch claim.
The upstream advanced-packaging request must naturally recall a TSMC management capacity or tester constraint, while attribution remains bounded later.
